findings.description: When ANSI is stripped, the prompt text is also stripped of leading and trailing whitespace, which the commit title does not mention. A prompt such as "Name: " is shown as "Name:" with no trailing space.
findings.rationale: Trigger: a prompt whose text ends in a space (the usual form, e.g. prompt("Name: ")) is run on a stream that does not support ANSI, such as a redirected or piped stderr/stdout. Mechanism: strip_ansi(text).strip() removes the trailing space along with the codes. Impact: the user sees the prompt run into the typed input ("Name:John"), and the output differs from the same prompt on a color-capable terminal, even though the change should only remove escape codes.
